freshGame.scanSource:
import json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path

games={g['id']:g for g in json.loads(Path('testdata/lichess_2026_10_26_post_pawnless_games.json').read_text())}
ids=[g['id'] for g in games.values() if g.get('variant')=='standard']
rows=[]
engine=subprocess.Popen(['./stockfish'],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
def send(s):engine.stdin.write(s+'\n');engine.stdin.flush()
def wait(s):
 for line in engine.stdout:
  if line.startswith(s):return
 raise RuntimeError('Stockfish exited')
send('uci');wait('uciok');send('setoption name Threads value 1');send('setoption name Hash value 32');send('isready');wait('readyok')
def analyze(fen,move=''):
 send('setoption name Clear Hash');send('isready');wait('readyok');send('position fen '+fen);send('go depth 16'+(' searchmoves '+move if move else ''))
 score=None;kind=None
 for line in engine.stdout:
  m=re.search(r' score (cp|mate) (-?\d+)',line)
  if m:kind=m[1];score=int(m[2]) if kind=='cp' else (100000 if int(m[2])>0 else -100000)
  if line.startswith('bestmove'):
   assert score is not None
   return score,line.split()[1],kind
 raise RuntimeError('Stockfish exited')
for gameid in ids:
 g=games[gameid]
 side='white' if g['players']['white'].get('user',{}).get('id')=='vadbot' else 'black'
 replay=subprocess.run(['/tmp/chess-oct26-before-parallel-verify','san-fens'],input=g['moves'],text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
 print('Scanning',gameid,side,g['speed'],flush=True)
 for line in replay.stdout.splitlines():
  parts=line.split(' | ')
  if len(parts)!=4:continue
  ply=int(parts[0]);san,played,fen=parts[1:]
  if (ply%2==1)!=(side=='white'):continue
  best,bestMove,kind=analyze(fen)
  if best < -500 or played == bestMove:continue
  playedScore,_,playedKind=analyze(fen,played)
  loss=max(0,best-playedScore)
  if loss>=80:
   clock=g['clocks'][ply-3]/100 if ply>=3 else g['clock']['initial']
   row=dict(gameId=gameid,speed=g['speed'],botSide=side,ply=ply,san=san,fen=fen,played=played,best=bestMove,bestScore=best,playedScore=playedScore,loss=loss,clockBeforeSeconds=clock,stockfishDepth=16,coldHash=True)
   rows.append(row);print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
 Path('testdata/lichess_2026_10_26_post_pawnless_move_scan.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
send('quit');engine.wait()
print('Completed',len(rows),'mistakes',flush=True)

import datetime, hashlib, json, os, shutil, signal, subprocess, time, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path('/home/vadim/code/GolangChessAI')
old_pid = 3556086
candidate = Path('/tmp/chess-oct26-preference-capture-native')
expected_old = '18f5032b7d01785219b0dd3ab4fa26f62b2333fa124057369701da5c7f030e32'
expected_new = 'b114885617ba38a9180e3c8f73fce7626e46a73dafefa340755d367188c47e03'

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

assert digest(repo / 'main') == expected_old
assert digest(f'/proc/{old_pid}/exe') == expected_old
assert digest(candidate) == expected_new
cmdline = Path(f'/proc/{old_pid}/cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
assert Path(os.fsdecode(cmdline[0])).resolve() == repo / 'main' and cmdline[1] == b'lichess'
env = dict(os.fsdecode(item).split('=', 1) for item in Path(f'/proc/{old_pid}/environ').read_bytes().split(b'\0') if b'=' in item)
request = urllib.request.Request('https://lichess.org/api/account/playing', headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + env['LICHESS_TOKEN']})
with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
    games = json.load(response)['nowPlaying']
if games:
    print('Deployment deferred: active games', [g['gameId'] for g in games], flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(130)

log_before = Path('/tmp/chess.lichess.log').read_bytes()
prefix_length = len(log_before)
prefix_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(log_before).hexdigest()
del log_before
assert Path('/proc/3671326').exists(), 'Separate web server must remain running'

backup = Path('/tmp/chess-oct26-main-before-preference-capture')
if backup.exists():
    assert digest(backup) == expected_old
else:
    shutil.copy2(repo / 'main', backup)
staging = repo / '.main-preference-capture-2026-10-26'
assert not staging.exists()
shutil.copy2(candidate, staging)
os.chmod(staging, (repo / 'main').stat().st_mode & 0o777)
os.replace(staging, repo / 'main')
os.kill(old_pid, signal.SIGTERM)
for _ in range(100):
    if not Path(f'/proc/{old_pid}').exists():
        break
    time.sleep(.05)
else:
    raise RuntimeError('Old bot did not exit; new binary installed but no second process started')

stamp = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()
logpath = Path('/tmp/chess.lichess.log')
with logpath.open('a', buffering=1) as output:
    output.write(f'=== DEPLOY {stamp} Opening fallback honors profitable-capture guard SHA256={expected_new} ===\n')
    output.flush()
    child = subprocess.Popen(['./main', 'lichess'], cwd=repo, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
    time.sleep(3)
    if child.poll() is not None:
        shutil.copy2(backup, staging)
        os.replace(staging, repo / 'main')
        restored = subprocess.Popen(['./main', 'lichess'], cwd=repo, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
        raise RuntimeError(f'Candidate exited; restored previous build PID {restored.pid}')
    actual = digest(f'/proc/{child.pid}/exe')
    assert actual == expected_new
    result = {'timestamp': stamp, 'oldPid': old_pid, 'pid': child.pid, 'binarySha256': actual, 'rollbackBinary': str(backup), 'noActiveGamesConfirmed': True}
    assert hashlib.sha256(logpath.read_bytes()[:prefix_length]).hexdigest() == prefix_sha256
    assert Path('/proc/3671326').exists()
    result.update(preservedLogBytes=prefix_length, preservedLogPrefixSha256=prefix_sha256, webServerPidPreserved=3671326)
    supervisor=Path('/tmp/chess-oct10-idle-run.py')
    old_supervisor=supervisor.read_text()
    assert str(old_pid) in old_supervisor
    supervisor.write_text(old_supervisor.replace(str(old_pid), str(child.pid)))
    Path('/tmp/chess-oct26-preference-capture-deployment.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
